description: Python package scaffold for the TGI client — pyproject.toml for typecheck, typed src/__init__.py, and a src/main.py entrypoint that exercises /generate and /generate_stream against a local TGI server.

buildHints.whenToUse: Always applied to tgi-server projects — provides the Python package structure (src/__init__.py, src/main.py, pyproject.toml) that wraps the docker-compose + client files supplied by the tgi-server family.
firstSteps: cp .env.example .env — fill in MODEL_ID and HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN
docker compose up -d — first boot pulls model weights (~15-60 GB) to ./data; watch `docker compose logs -f` until the health-check passes
python -m src.main                         # blocking /generate with default prompt
gotchas: Run as a module (`python -m src.main`), not a script (`python src/main.py`) — the relative import `from .client import …` requires the package context.
mypy runs in strict mode; all three deps (httpx, huggingface_hub, pydantic) ship py.typed markers so `mypy src/` passes clean after `pip install -r requirements.txt`.
TGI_URL defaults to http://localhost:8080 — if you changed the port mapping in docker-compose.yml, set TGI_URL in .env before running the client.

placeholders.description: DEFAULT_PROMPT — replace with your actual test prompt before shipping.
